execution: Each complete query is a separate batch. Record the actual SQLSTATE, not merely HTTP status. A failing statement aborts its transaction; confirm rollback or connection closure, then run the independent readback. Do not run fragments or continue an uncertain transaction.

limits: No actual TRUNCATE attempt: the main DML batch checks the exact missing TRUNCATE privilege through catalog functions.
The audit UPDATE has WHERE false and can affect no records even if an unexpected grant exists; an unexpected successful query is a failed privilege test.
These expected errors are separate from the no-error DML rollback batch and are not passing evidence until actually executed and recorded.
No Study request, token issuance, admission, account role assignment, provider call, or hosted Auth session is tested here.
